answer_2.quote: For Single-VEQA queries, we use accuracy (Acc) as an evaluation metric. For Group-VEQA queries, we employ recall (Recall) as the metric.

answer_4.quote: Human identification accuracy reaches 98.31% when incorporating matching clues. We selected two well‑known and highly capable MLLMs, as well as human evaluation, to serve as baselines.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators provided the correct answers, and model outputs were compared against these human answers.
